items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Alfred Bonds played E-flat clarinet. Now we went to play. We went up about four miles from home to a little dance. And they had a little orchestra there.

ctx.x: How much older was the oldest brother than you?
Just about three years different. Freddie Bonds was the second. Then Alfred Bonds. Then I had a sister. Well, she's older than I am. It was four boys and one girl. Did she play any instrument?
No, she didn't. Piano, guitar, nothing like that?
